scripts.infra:up: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('infra/.env'))fs.copyFileSync('infra/.env.example','infra/.env')" && npm run build -w services/nakama && npm run build -w services/sim && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env up -d --wait --build
scripts.infra:reload: npm run build -w services/nakama && npm run build -w services/sim && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env up -d --wait --build --force-recreate nakama
scripts.infra:prod:up: node infra/check-env.mjs && npm run build -w services/nakama && npm run build -w services/sim && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file infra/.env up -d --build --wait
scripts.infra:prod:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file infra/.env logs -f --tail=200
scripts.infra:prod:stop: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file infra/.env stop
